ooze: A thick and often unpleasant liquid.
You should put on cleaning gloves if you are going to clean up that nasty ooze.
When something oozes out, it refers to liquid slowly flowing out.
Blood oozed out of the cut.

oops: You say oops when you make a small mistake, do something by accident, or fall down.
oodles: A very large amount or number of something; lots.
The library has oodles of books for children.
